description: List all phone numbers in your account. Returns each number with its ID, status, country, and the agent it is assigned to (if any).

limit.description: How many numbers to return in one page.

offset.description: How many numbers to skip before this page, for paging through a long list.

name: list_numbers

outputSchema.description: A page of the account's phone numbers.

data.description: The phone numbers on this page.

items.description: A phone number in the account.

agentId.description: ID of the agent this number is assigned to, or null if unassigned.

country.description: ISO country code the number belongs to.

id.description: The phone number's unique ID (use as number_id elsewhere).

phoneNumber.description: The number in E.164 format, e.g. +14155550123.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Phone Numbers
